01

Build a signal flow

建立信号流程

Choose sources, add calculations and connect one result to several outputs. Save the complete plan to use it again.

选择来源、添加计算，将一个结果连接到多个输出，再保存整套方案以便复用。

↗ 02

Connect and record

连接输出与录制

Set up OSC, DG-LAB, MIDI or device outputs. Record funscript tracks, download completed segments and replay them.

配置 OSC、DG-LAB、MIDI 或设备输出，录制 funscript 轨道、下载完成片段并重新播放。

↗ 03

Choose your task

按目标选择方案

Start with manual controls or scripts, combine signals, or add VRChat parameters and root tracking when your task needs them.
